name: Kawaii Weapon Mods
teaser: Existing weapon mods with retextures added in new shops
description_html:
Information: Adds 2 new traders that sell a heap of existing weapon mods with different retextures. Each with there own flavour.

ZERO: Will have mostly Camo weapon mods, a bit of red or the more tactical and cool look approach to guns.
KYUUTO: Will have all of your anime needs, pastel colours and more cute designs.
Seperated for convenience.

Installation: Simply download the file from the link and extract it into your /User/Mods folder. Easy. Configuration:

The config file allows you to choose which items to appear in the trader list, simply change the value to true/false and it will show or not show in the trader sell list.
(may help with the overloading issue if some are set to false)

Shoutout: I want to personally thank Revingly for putting up with me as he helped me do so much with this. It was a headache for me and he made it look easy.
So thank you a lot! I really appreciate the help as I learnt a lot.
